description: Design-operator activation magnitudes, gains and parameter clamps: one OPERATION_POLICY per operator (subject = operator id, role = operator category).

rules.title: OP_ENCLOSE_BREATHING_FIELD: activation, gain and negative-space bounds

payload.subject: OP_ENCLOSE_BREATHING_FIELD
payload.rationale: Active while the SOLID_VOID magnitude is below solid_void_enclosed_magnitude; raises negative space by (1 - magnitude) * enclosure_gain. The result is bounded by the effective band of negative space of the context (ADR-0001: negative_space_min/max are band edges, not local numbers); a raising operator never lowers the ratio.

rules.title: OP_ALIGN_GUEST_HOST_TENSION: target host/guest ratio and centering strength

payload.subject: OP_ALIGN_GUEST_HOST_TENSION
payload.rationale: Active while the HOST_GUEST dominance ratio is below target_ratio; the focal point is pulled toward the frame centre by centering_factor = (target_ratio - ratio) / target_ratio, applied with centering_strength.

rules.title: OP_PARTITION_POISSON_CLUSTER: activation, gain and symmetry clamp

payload.subject: OP_PARTITION_POISSON_CLUSTER
payload.rationale: Active while the DENSE_SPARSE magnitude is below dense_sparse_contrast_magnitude; lowers axial symmetry by (1 - magnitude) * symmetry_reduction_gain, clamped to [symmetry_min, symmetry_max].

rules.title: OP_CALIBRATE_AXIAL_ORDER: period gate and axial symmetry target

payload.subject: OP_CALIBRATE_AXIAL_ORDER
payload.rationale: Period-specific: only the 雄浑巨构 TANG paradigm requires strong central-axis symmetry (flag applies_to_period). Where enabled and axial symmetry is below axial_symmetry_target, it is calibrated up to the target.

rules.title: OP_LAYER_DEPTH_RECESSION: canonical depth layers per period

payload.subject: OP_LAYER_DEPTH_RECESSION
payload.rationale: TANG 4 (雄浑巨构，多层进深) / SONG 5 (山水意境，深远层次) / MING 3 (简雅秩序，适度进深); NEAR_FAR magnitude >= 0.5 means depth recession is already present.

rules.title: OP_INJECT_ATMOSPHERIC_VOID: activation, gain and ambient clamp

payload.subject: OP_INJECT_ATMOSPHERIC_VOID
payload.rationale: Active when the BOUNDARY node energy reaches boundary_energy_min (hard depth edges); raises the ambient ratio by energy * ambient_gain, clamped to [ambient_min, ambient_max]. The ambient clamp is defined here once and shared by the cool-shadow and mist-scatter operators ($ref).

rules.title: OP_SHIFT_HORIZON_PROPORTION: mediocre horizon band and period pitch target

payload.subject: OP_SHIFT_HORIZON_PROPORTION
payload.rationale: Active when the camera pitch lies within the mediocre band (|angle| <= mediocre_angle_band degrees); sets the period canonical pitch target_angle: TANG -15 (虫眼仰角，凸显雄浑巨构), SONG 10 (俯瞰苍茫，山水意境), MING -5 (适度仰视，秩序庄严).

rules.title: OP_FRAME_SECONDARY_OCCLUSION: activation, gain and negative-space bounds

payload.subject: OP_FRAME_SECONDARY_OCCLUSION
payload.rationale: Active while the OPEN_CLOSE magnitude is below open_close_contained_magnitude; lowers negative space by (1 - magnitude) * framing_gain * negative_space_compression. The result is bounded by the effective band of negative space of the context (ADR-0001: negative_space_min/max are band edges, not local numbers); a lowering operator never raises the ratio.

rules.title: OP_APPLY_TIME_PATINA: activation, gains and roughness / wear clamps

payload.subject: OP_APPLY_TIME_PATINA
payload.rationale: Active while the MATERIAL energy is below material_energy_varied; patina = (1 - energy) * patina_gain adds patina * roughness_gain to roughness (clamped to roughness_min/max) and patina * wear_gain to wear (clamped to wear_min/max) of the dominant material. The wear clamp is shared with the surface-entropy operator ($ref).

rules.title: OP_DAMPEN_SPECULAR_HARSHNESS: activation, gain and softness clamp

payload.subject: OP_DAMPEN_SPECULAR_HARSHNESS
payload.rationale: Active when the HEAVY_LIGHT magnitude reaches heavy_light_harsh_magnitude; raises key light softness by magnitude * dampen_gain, clamped to [softness_min, softness_max].

payload.subject: OP_ORCHESTRATE_MATERIAL_CONTRAST
payload.rationale: Needs two materials; dominant -> roughness_low_target, secondary -> roughness_high_target. TANG 0.25/0.65 (金石低糙，木石高糙，对比强烈), SONG 0.35/0.6 (清润，适度对比), MING 0.4/0.55 (简雅，温润接近). Skipped when the current spread already reaches spread_satisfied_fraction of the target spread.

rules.title: OP_WEATHER_SURFACE_ENTROPY: activation, gain and wear clamp

payload.subject: OP_WEATHER_SURFACE_ENTROPY
payload.rationale: Active while the TIME energy is below time_energy_weathered; raises wear of the dominant material by (1 - energy) * entropy_gain, clamped to the wear clamp defined once in the time-patina operator ($ref).

rules.title: OP_HARMONIZE_SKY_LUMINANCE: conflict threshold, gain and intensity clamp

payload.subject: OP_HARMONIZE_SKY_LUMINANCE
payload.rationale: Active when the LIGHT energy reaches light_energy_conflict while a rim light is present; removes the rim light and lowers key intensity by (energy - light_energy_conflict) * harmonize_gain, clamped to [intensity_min, intensity_max]. The intensity clamp is defined here once and shared with the accent-luminance operator ($ref).

rules.title: OP_COOL_SHADOW_CHROMATICITY: activation, gain and ambient clamp

payload.subject: OP_COOL_SHADOW_CHROMATICITY
payload.rationale: Active while the HIGH_LOW magnitude is below high_low_differentiated_magnitude; raises the ambient ratio by (1 - magnitude) * shadow_gain, clamped to the ambient clamp defined once in the atmospheric-void operator ($ref).

rules.title: OP_FILTER_MIST_SCATTER: hard-light condition, gains and softness clamp

payload.subject: OP_FILTER_MIST_SCATTER
payload.rationale: Active for hard light (LIGHT energy >= hard_light_energy_min and softness < hard_light_softness_max); scatter = energy * (1 - softness) * scatter_gain raises softness (clamped to softness_min/max) and ambient by scatter * ambient_scatter_fraction (ambient clamp shared via $ref).

rules.title: OP_RESTRICT_ACCENT_LUMINANCE: accent limit, proxy scale and intensity clamp

payload.subject: OP_RESTRICT_ACCENT_LUMINANCE
payload.rationale: Accent area share must stay <= accent_area_limit. Strength proxy = max(0, colour temperature bias) * key intensity, compared with accent_area_limit * accent_proxy_scale; the excess lowers intensity by reduction * intensity_reduction_gain, clamped to the intensity clamp defined once in the sky-luminance operator ($ref).
